mechanism: Reconstructs deal history into per-bar Starting Balance, Balance, Equity, and Floating P/L curves via HistorySelect, position cache, and multi-symbol price cache; visualizes account risk/drawdown behavior, not market state.
data_needed: Account deal history; per-bar OHLC of traded symbols for floating P/L; InpHistoryBars; InpUpdatePeriod
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any chart symbol/TF; multi-symbol positions tracked via CopyRates/iClose
why_new_for_mis: Full read shows account-performance analytics chrome, not a market regime/liquidity/vol sensor for MIS.
quote: Understanding the relationship between your balance, equity, and floating profit or loss over time reveals patterns about your risk management

mechanism: Compute log return r=ln(close[i]/close[i+1]); over InpLookback bars estimate rolling mean μ and stdev σ of log returns (population variance from sum/sumsq); SigmaScore=(r−μ)/σ with ±InpUpper/LowerThreshold guide lines (default ±2). Extreme |σ| flags unusual impulses vs recent regime; zero-vol guard outputs 0.
data_needed: Close series; InpLookback (default 20); upper/lower sigma thresholds
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic MT5 any symbol/TF; fat-tail caveat noted
why_new_for_mis: Single-number market-stress / anomaly meter in sigma units of log returns—ready MIS volatility-shock and regime-stretch feature without needing a full strategy.
quote: How many standard deviations is the current bar’s return away from the average return of the last N bars?

mechanism: Over lookback N compute mean and stddev of tick_volume; normalize each bar as n_vol = volume/stddev; map n_vol into discrete bubble sizes (<1…≥4 → font sizes 24…56) plotted above highs; color green/orange by volume rising/falling vs prior bar; labels at n_vol≥4. Prefer tick volume (forex) with real-volume awareness.
data_needed: tick_volume[] (or real volume); lookback N (default 30); chart objects lifecycle
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Forex tick-volume focus; stocks/futures real volume noted; any MT5 TF
why_new_for_mis: Participation intensity as adaptive stdev-normalized bubble stream—liquidity surge sensor comparable across changing volume regimes, not raw histogram height.
quote: To get a normalized value, we divide its raw volume by the standard deviation. This figure indicates how many standard deviations the volume of this candle is above the average.

mechanism: Export OHLCV for 14 instruments; build covariates (cyclical time, Tokyo/London/NY/overlap sessions, moon phases, FRED econ events FOMC/NFP/CPI/GDP, atr_norm/volume_norm/spread_norm/returns); LoRA-adapt TimesFM 2.5 (rank 4, last 2 of 20 layers, ~102K params) on H1 context=512 horizon=48; forecast_with_covariates yields point + q10/q50/q90 confidence bands drawn on MT5. Session and macro covariates explicitly encode liquidity/vol regime shifts.
data_needed: H1 OHLCV (~50k bars); FRED API; moon ephem; LoRA adapter; CSV bridge to MQL5 indicator
why_new_for_mis: Foundation-model sequence sensor with session/macro covariates and explicit uncertainty bands—MIS can treat q-band width and session flags as live neural regime/vol features across multi-asset H1.
quote: Volatility and liquidity regimes change with trading sessions

mechanism: Anchor base to first close; for each subsequent close compute bricks=floor(|Δprice|/brickSize); continue trend one brick at a time; reverse only if opposite move ≥2 bricks (filters one-brick noise flips); store brick closes in dynamic array capped by InpNumBricks; draw OBJ_RECTANGLE overlay per chart TF. Brick size is raw price interval (e.g. 0.0001 EURUSD, 1 XAUUSD).
data_needed: Close series; InpBrickSize; InpNumBricks; up/down colors
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD (0.0001), XAUUSD (1) examples; rebuilds per chart TF
why_new_for_mis: Time-agnostic price-step regime with explicit two-brick confirmation as a change sensor—cleaner trend/reversal state than candle noise for MIS filters.
quote: reversals require at least two bricks in the opposite direction to avoid false flips

mechanism: Time-delay embed closes (m, τ); build NxN recurrence matrix via Euclidean/Max/Manhattan distance ≤ε (ε via fixed, std-fraction, range-fraction, or RR-target bisection default RR≈0.05); extract RR, DET (diagonal determinism), LAM (vertical laminarity/trapping), ENTR, TREND (diagonal-density regression slope for non-stationarity), plus L/Lmax/TT/Vmax/DIV/RATIO/COMPLEXITY; CRQAWindow rolls metrics onto chart buffers. High DET→rule-governed; high LAM→consolidation; TREND→drift/regime shift.
data_needed: Close window (typ. 50–200); embDim/delay; ε method; min diag/vert line lengths; step
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 demo; GBPUSD M30 demo; any symbol/TF
why_new_for_mis: Nonlinear dynamics metric stack (DET/LAM/ENTR/TREND) is a ready MIS regime+change panel beyond linear indicators; RR-target ε keeps recurrence density comparable across instruments.
quote: Using DET and LAM thresholds to classify market regimes (trending, ranging, transitioning).

mechanism: CopyHigh/Low/Close/TickVolume (fallback RealVolume) for lookback; split [priceMin,priceMax] into N_BINS equal bins; accumulate volume of candles whose close falls in bin (with ±step edge overlap); normalize widths to MAX_BAR_WIDTH; draw profile rectangles; POC horizontals where normalized width > POC_THRESHOLD (mid-bin price). Prefer tick volume; volume weight not candle count.
data_needed: OHLC+tick/real volume; InpLookback; N_BINS=100; MAX_BAR_WIDTH; POC_THRESHOLD; profile/POC toggles
why_new_for_mis: Close-assigned volume-by-price spectrum with thresholded multi-POC liquidity lines—explicit where participation concentrates inside a lookback for MIS liquidity maps.
quote: identify high-volume zones known as the Point of Control (POC), which represent the most active price levels where the highest trading activity occurred.

mechanism: MTFEngine.mqh registers iMA/iRSI/iATR/etc. handles once in OnInit, ReadBuffer defaults bar_shift=1, IsReady checks CopyBuffer+iTime(HTF,1), ReleaseAll on deinit; demo EURUSD H1 with D1 EMA/H4 RSI/H1 cross. Infrastructure for leak-free closed-bar MTF reads, not a market sensor itself.
data_needed: Indicator handles per symbol/TF; new-bar gate
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 demo; D1/H4/H1 layers; Index0 vs Index1 experiment 223 vs 171 signals
why_new_for_mis: Full read is MQL5 plumbing to prevent handle leaks and phantom index-0 signals—enables sensing stacks but is not itself a MIS sense.
quote: ReadBuffer() in MTFEngine.mqh defaults to bar_shift = 1. That single default is the entire fix.

mechanism: EA creates custom symbol from source template; aggregates live ticks into OHLC bars that close after InpTicksPerBar (default 30) via CustomRatesUpdate; monotonic unique timestamps; forming bar updated every tick. Each candle encodes fixed activity quantum rather than clock time—dense tick periods compress wall-clock, sparse stretch it.
data_needed: Source symbol ticks (bid); InpCustomSymbol; InpTicksPerBar; optional auto ChartOpen
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD→TICK_101 examples; EURUSD 10-tick illustration; M1 chart as display container
why_new_for_mis: Activity-driven bar clock is a microstructure/intensity sensing frame MIS can subscribe to when time-bars hide participation bursts.
quote: each candle reflects market activity density rather than elapsed time.

mechanism: Scan lookback for 4 swings (bullish: HH then LL after HL/LH sequence with SwingLookback=3); refine to true extremes per leg; validate no premature close beyond diverging trendlines; require second expansion ≤1.5× first range; confirm breakout close beyond upper (bull) with opposite boundary intact; SL=mid structure height, TP=measured move. Expanding HH/LL structure senses rising uncertainty/volatility regime before directional break.
data_needed: OHLC; look_back≈300; SwingLookback; proportional expansion limit 1.5
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic MT5 chart; bullish path detailed, bearish symmetric
why_new_for_mis: Rule-based broadening-formation detector as an expanding-volatility / uncertainty-regime sensor with validated breakout change trigger—not discretionary drawing.
quote: price swings grow more aggressive and result in greater gaps between successive swing highs and swing lows

mechanism: Embed two equal-length series; JR(i,j)=1 iff ||x_i−x_j||≤εX AND ||y_i−y_j||≤εY (inline AND of self-recurrences); extract JRR/JDET/JLAM/JENTR/JTREND (+ full 12). JRR near min(RR_X,RR_Y)→independent; near individual RRs→tight coupling. Positive JTREND→increasing synchronized recurrence (coupling regime shift). Indicator aligns timestamps, log-return+zscore normalizes, OpenCL/CPU rolling windows; default pair GBPUSD vs chart.
data_needed: Two aligned OHLC series; shared/separate ε; window/step; embDim/delay; normalization mode
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD vs GBPUSD demos; any second symbol input
why_new_for_mis: Synchronized dual-instrument regime coupling (not shared price levels) via joint recurrence—MIS cross-asset change sensor orthogonal to correlation or CRQA territory overlap.
quote: JRQA detects synchronized regime behavior. Two instruments can visit similar price levels (high CRQA) without being in the same dynamical regime at the same time.

mechanism: Treat recurrence matrix (diagonal zeroed) as undirected graph adjacency; CRNAMetrics computes AvgClustering (ACC), Transitivity, AvgPathLength/Diameter, Betweenness (Brandes), Closeness, Assortativity, Density/degree stats. High ACC→coherent clustered regimes; low NormAPL→small-world interconnected states; high betweenness nodes→transitional bridges; assortativity→hub-hub vs hub-peripheral structure. Rolling CRNAWindow/CJRNAWindow (+ JRNA cross-symbol) plot ACC/Transitivity/NormAPL/Assortativity/AvgBetweenness.
data_needed: Close window (~50 typical; N³ cost caution >100); ε (RR-target or fixed); embDim/delay; optional second symbol for JRNA
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 RNA; EURUSD–GBPUSD JRNA; any symbol/TF
why_new_for_mis: Graph-topology view of recurrence (clustering, path length, betweenness bridges) senses regime coherence and transitions that line-counting DET/LAM miss—richer MIS nonlinear state features from the same RP.
quote: a time point with high betweenness connects otherwise separate clusters of recurrence. It may correspond to a transitional state between market regimes.
